Tara (CS): Heads-up: RhineHealth's monthly burn just jumped; QBR next week and our projection moved +34%. Need a rapid mitigation + a customer note.
Diego (FinOps): On it 44d Which endpoints are responsible?
Aria (Onboarding): Bulk ingestion + daily re-embed job. They also bumped embedding dimension in a recent deploy.
Conor (Solutions): Confirmed: `embedding.dim=1536`. Our recommended is 512. Also their duplicate-detection is re-processing identical docs which amplifies load.
AlertBot: :warning: Project RHN-21 at 80% monthly credits.
Diego (FinOps): If left alone, extra monthly spend ~ $10.8k. Quick mitigations: pause re-embeds, flip to lower-dim/quant model, enable dedupe+cache, and soft quota. Which should we do first?
Aria (Onboarding): Pausing re-embed is immediate. I can flip model via config patch in the console right now. Dedupe needs a short config change in their pipeline but we can add proxy caching as a stopgap.
Tara (CS): I'll message the customer saying we paused the re-embed and want a 30m ops call. Need a one-slide summary: impact, short-term fixes, and asks (credits buffer or Dedicated micro-trial). Can someone draft numbers?
Diego (FinOps): Quick back-of-envelope: model flip to `embed-512-quant` -> ~60% compute reduction; proxy caching + dedupe -> additional ~15%. Combined ~68%. With throttling we can nudge to ~75% reduction.
Conor (Solutions): Runbook snippet for engineers (paste to ops):
```
# pause job
POST /v1/projects/RHN-21/jobs/reembed/pause

# quick config patch to lower-dim model
PATCH /v1/projects/RHN-21/config
{ "embedding_model": "embed-512-quant", "embedding_dim": 512 }

# set soft quota via API
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/RHN-21/quota" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"soft_limit_pct":65, "hard_limit_pct":90}'
```
Aria (Onboarding): Paused re-embed at 08:04 PT. Requeues set to manual approval.
Tara (CS): For the QBR ask: propose primary = 10-day Dedicated micro trial so they see stable throughput; fallback = one-time 15% credits buffer tied to adoption milestones. Which do we want to push?
Diego (FinOps): Dedicated trial preferred. It reduces renewal risk and shows predictable economics. Credits buffer if customer insists on speed.
Conor (Solutions): I'll prepare an appendix with per-route token breakdown and duplicated-doc rate to show in the QBR.
AlertBot: :white_check_mark: Incident created: RHN-cost-surge assigned to #customer-success.
Tara (CS): Action items: Diego finalize slide with numbers (ETA 90m), Conor add appendix & runbook, Aria keep imports paused until we speak to customer, Tara draft customer message and schedule ops call.
Aria (Onboarding): Confirmed f44d no further re-embeds until explicit sign-off.
Diego (FinOps): Adding renewal risk flag: medium-high. I'll notify AM and include recommended contingency (trial vs credits) in the slide.
Tara (CS): I'll draft the customer note: short apology, paused job, ops call invite, and two mitigation options. Will share here in 30m for quick review.
Conor (Solutions): Also add a tiny snippet for immediate dev-level throttle:
```
# throttle example (pseudo)
batcher.set_max_concurrency(5)
batcher.set_rate_limit(80/s)
```
Tara (CS): Great work team. We'll present mitigations + the Dedicated trial ask in the QBR and offer the credits buffer only as fallback. Update thread after slide upload. :thumbsup:
